topics.claim: A pipe-related state observation during death may be inherited SMB3 engine behavior rather than caused by Three Shields.

host02_observation.scenario: Automated World 1-1 run at both modified PRG0 and modified PRG1
host02_observation.result: No genuine pipe entry or exit observed; $058C alone insufficient

competing_explanations: Original engine transiently sets/retains pipe-related state during death or other animation
Three Shields alters timing and produces unexpected state interaction
Incorrect meaning or aliasing of an observed RAM flag
acceptance: Record stock PRG0, patched PRG0, stock PRG1 and patched PRG1 with the same input movie and initial conditions.
Capture per-frame $0571 Level_PipeMove, $058C Player_InPipe, $03DE Level_JctCtl, $0729 Map_Operation, $0552 invulnerability, $0553 Star, $7FCE HP, $ED suit, $0736 lives.
For write/exec event, capture CPU PC plus MMC3-qualified physical PRG bank and relevant call path.
Require native pipe-entrance, destination and exit events; a nonzero $058C flag alone is not a pipe pass.
Repeat boundary collisions and normal pipe traversal in unmodified ROM before classifying behavior as pre-existing.

topics.claim: The documented World 7-1 wrong warp can corrupt/redirect level traversal with sprite-slot manipulation and may interact with damage timing.
topics.caveat: Do not assume the World 1-1 death flag is the World 7-1 wrong warp; reproduction and CPU trace are required.

topics.claim: Tanooki statue transformation during Hammer Suit pickup can create Gray Hammer Mario, invulnerable but unable to use exit pipes.
topics.test: Naturally acquire Tanooki and Hammer Suit in the appropriate level, capture item collision and statue state in stock and patched ROMs; distinguish expected legacy behavior from a new regression.

publication_rule: No checkbox promotion without revision-qualified Mesen runtime receipts and a verified native transition/pickup witness.
